# Olaniran Afouda

> Backend and systems engineer at Flash, building Bitcoin/Lightning infrastructure and fintech payment systems in West Africa and the Caribbean. Works on on/off ramps, payment orchestration, double-entry ledgers, and reconciliation. Writes seminar notes on Lightning protocol internals.

## Pages

- [Home (EN)](https://olaniran.space/): profile, experience, selected work, communities
- [Accueil (FR)](https://olaniran.space/fr/): version française du profil
- [Notes (EN)](https://olaniran.space/blog/): Lightning protocol seminar notes
- [Notes (FR)](https://olaniran.space/fr/blog/): index français des notes

## Notes

- [Hash Timelocked Contract (HTLC)](https://olaniran.space/2025/03/09/hash-timelocked-contract/): how HTLCs make Lightning payments atomic and trustless
- [Where MAC and HMAC are implemented in the Lightning Protocol — and why](https://olaniran.space/2025/03/12/mac-hmac-in-lightning/): message authentication in Lightning node communications
- [Causes of routing failures in Lightning Protocol](https://olaniran.space/2025/03/19/lightning-routing-failures/): why multi-hop payments fail and their network impact
